'''Vrrisk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. He was killed in the mining complex during the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]].
